sceneConcept: A lean thirty-seven-year-old Chinese senior bank officer stands alone against a transparent background in the most presentable form of regulation dress. His immaculate side-parted black hair, dark brown half-lidded eyes and smooth unreadable expression distinguish him from an older worried manager. He wears a precise double-breasted charcoal suit, crisp white shirt, muted blue tie, narrow silver tie clip, folded pocket square and polished black shoes. Standing at a slight three-quarter angle, he keeps both arms composed behind his back and meets the viewer with faultless polite distance. Soft even frontal studio light preserves the quiet formal geometry.
